仅清理项目缓存；不删除项目、原素材、校对文字、逐句配音、最终输出、模型或运行环境: Only project caches are removed. Projects, source media, corrected text, synthesized clips, final outputs, models and runtimes are preserved.
安全缓存：已完成分离的输入副本与分块: Safe caches: input copies and chunks from completed separation
可重建缓存：分析音频、RTF 参考与中文中间轨、混音背景: Rebuildable caches: analysis audio, RTF reference, dubbing stem and mix background
人声分离结果：以后重新处理需再次运行分离模型: Separated stems: future processing will need to run separation again
未完成分离的断点默认保留。清理不可撤销，但所列缓存可重新计算；不会自动删除整个项: Incomplete separation checkpoints are preserved. Cleanup is irreversible, but these caches can be rebuilt. Entire projects are never deleted.
我已确认清理范围；需要时允许重新计算缓存: I have reviewed the scope and accept rebuilding caches when needed
请等待当前项目或批量任务结束后再扫描清理。: Wait for the current project or batch task to finish before cleaning caches.
替换配音成品 + 原声（分离背景 + 配音，实验性，不推荐）: Replacement dub + original (separated background + dubbing; experimental, not recommended)

启用音频片段复核后，可在这里查看差异。: Enable audio review to inspect proposals here.
原音频片段（所有模型共享原始声音）: Source clip (same audio for every model)
换行上限，不合并不同句子。已有项目请选择「仅当前项目」或「两者」，保存后重新生成: Wrapping limit; does not merge cues. For an existing project, choose Current project or Both, save, then regenerate subtitles.
原声视频也编码硬字幕: Burn subtitles into the original-audio video too
队列为空。完成的作品会写入各自的输出目录。: Queue is empty. Results are written to each work's output directory.
音轨组织（分轨字幕始终沿用音频原名）: Track layout (per-track subtitles retain audio filenames)
随机选择背景/角色图片: Choose a random background / character image
允许覆盖并替换本作品已生成的旧结果: Allow replacing this work's existing results
时间戳文档附加文字位置: Extra text position in timestamp document
使用现有台本或字幕（可选）: Use an existing script or subtitles (optional)
普通台本校对会使用当前翻译设置中的大模型；DeepL、Google Cloud: Untimed-script review uses the LLM configured for translation. DeepL, Google Cloud Translation and Microsoft Translator do not support this mode.
识别后使用 Qwen3 ForcedAligner 0.6B（日语）重新计算时间: Realign Japanese timestamps with Qwen3 ForcedAligner 0.6B
VAD 与当前后端不兼容: VAD is incompatible with this backend
日语与英语分别保存。直接编辑会标为自定义；点击下方按钮可恢复当前语言的内置版本。: Japanese and English prompts are stored separately. Editing marks a prompt as custom; restore the built-in version below.
中文替换：分离背景 + 中文（必须开启分离，实验性，不推荐）: Chinese replacement: separated background + Chinese (requires separation; experimental, not recommended)
实验性，效果可能不如单模型。: Experimental; may perform worse than a single model.
选择一种工作方式：单个作品适合逐句校对；批量处理适合按作品扫描、选择并排队。: Use Single project for sentence-level editing, or Batch processing to scan and queue works.
新建或打开项目后，按下面的 1–5 步处理。每一步都会自动保存。: Create or open a project, then follow steps 1–5. Each processing step saves automatically.
请先选择原始文件新建项目，或从最近项目中继续。: Choose a source file to create a project, or open a recent project.
仅在设置里保存；界面不会回显已保存密钥: Stored in settings; saved secrets are never shown
RTF（原声空间线索迁移）参数（未启用时不生效）: RTF (original spatial cue transfer) parameters (inactive when disabled)
允许本次从 PyPI/PyTorch/GitHub/Hugging Face 下: Allow downloads from PyPI/PyTorch/GitHub/Hugging Face (may use several GB; model licenses apply)
原音频片段（含上下文，保留原声道）: Source clip (with context and original channels)
只重试音频复核（不重跑完整主 ASR）: Retry audio review only (keep primary ASR)
同意上传音频到所选分离服务（实验性，不推荐）: Consent to audio upload to the selected separation service (experimental; not recommended)
恢复当前语言的内置 Prompt: Restore built-in prompt for this source language
我确认执行所选修复：微软运行库从官方联网下载并验证签名，可能请求管理员权限；后端: I confirm this repair. Microsoft runtimes are downloaded from official sources and signatures verified; elevation may be requested. Backend repair may download dependencies/models and replace runtimes.
文字确认后：仅重新对齐时间（Qwen3）: After text review: realign timestamps only (Qwen3)
时间戳文档与标题（不影响字幕正文翻译）: Timestamp documents & titles (separate from subtitle translation)
本次新建项目的音频语言: Source language for this new project
每个非空行作为一句；选择文件时，粘贴内容优先。: Each nonempty line becomes a sentence. Pasted text takes precedence over a selected file.
识别后使用 Qwen3 ForcedAligner 0.6B（阿里）重新计算时间: Realign timestamps after ASR with Qwen3 ForcedAligner 0.6B
载入当前项目的 TTS 设置（替换本页草稿）: Load project TTS settings (replace this draft)
输入后点击保存；界面不会回显已保存密钥: Enter and save; stored keys are never displayed
输出组织（分轨字幕可沿用音频原名）: Output layout (track subtitles can retain audio filenames)
重做并替换本工具生成的旧结果: Redo & replace this tool's existing results
音频复核提案：试听、采纳与撤销: Audio review proposals: listen, accept & undo
音频对应原文（部分外部 TTS 需要）: Reference transcript (required by some TTS APIs)
0 不改变原始音量；负数降低，正数提高。: 0 keeps the original level; negative lowers it, positive raises it.
0 表示从原字幕开始；负数提前，正数延后。: 0 starts at the original subtitle time; negative is earlier, positive later.
“仅中文克隆音轨”会导出一条与原文件等长的 WAV，方便单独编辑。之后改回包含混: Chinese-stem-only exports a WAV for separate editing. Switch back to mixed output and remix without resynthesizing speech.
一句中文太轻时最多自动提高多少；限制提升可避免底噪被过度放大，默认 12。: Maximum boost for a quiet sentence. Limits noise amplification; default 12 dB.
一句文字被模型拆成多段时，在段间插入的静音。: Silence inserted between segments when the model splits a sentence.
下面只列出本地已完整下载并可运行的识别模型。: Only complete, locally available ASR models are listed.
中文配音通常保持“中文”；仅在文本实际为其它语言时切换。: Keep Chinese for Chinese dubbing. Change only when the text is actually in another language.
也可以粘贴 project.json 的完整路径。: You can also paste the full project.json path.
从左到右填写优先级，例如 wav,flac,ape,m4a,mp3；只会选其中存: Priority from left to right, e.g. wav,flac,ape,m4a,mp3. Only one available format is selected.
使用可选 DeepSpeed 推理；未安装或加载失败时由上游回退普通推理。: Optional DeepSpeed inference; upstream falls back when unavailable or loading fails.
关闭后输出更确定；开启通常更自然，并受 Temperature、Top P/To: Disable for more deterministic output. When enabled, Temperature and Top P/K control sampling.
分轨沿用音频名，多个音轨合并使用作品文件夹名。输出到成品目录，不覆盖源字幕。: Tracks use audio filenames; merged output uses the work folder name. Source subtitles are not overwritten.
勾选后字幕直接显示在视频里；无论是否内嵌，都会另外保留 SRT 和 LRC。: Include subtitles in the video. Separate SRT and LRC are retained either way.
勾选后把附加音轨也加入本次任务；不勾选只处理主要音轨。: Include extra tracks in this task; otherwise process main tracks only.
包括特典、样本、Free Talk 和闹钟等附加内容；批量页可按作品改。: Includes bonuses, samples, Free Talk and alarms. Override per work in Batch processing.
原片段很响时，中文目标不会高于这个值，避免跟随结果过响；默认 -30。: Caps the Chinese target for loud source clips; default −30 dBFS.
原片段非常安静时，中文目标不会低于这个值，避免配音几乎听不见；默认 -42。: Floor for Chinese targets with very quiet source clips; default −42 dBFS.
只作为下一次批量任务的初始值。: Initial value for the next batch task only.
只作为视频任务的初始值；批量页扫描后可以改选作品图片。: Initial video setting; choose a different image after scanning.
只在累计概率范围内采样。: Sample within this cumulative probability mass.
只影响默认值；批量页可按作品关闭。: Default only; can be disabled per work.
只显示当前识别后端可用且本地已经安装的方式。ASMR 专用 VAD 不会修改原音: Shows installed methods compatible with the current backend. ASMR VAD does not modify source audio.
只清理所选作品输出目录里的 AutoFlow 成品和状态；不会修改原作品文件。普: Replaces AutoFlow outputs/state for the selected work, not source files. Leave off for ordinary resume.
可以直接填写服务商提供或账号中已创建的音色 ID。: Enter a voice ID provided by the service or created in your account.
可传递服务商特有字段；不要覆盖 model、input。: Provider-specific fields; do not override model or input.
可使用某个已下载 ASR 的自带时间戳，或用 Qwen3 ForcedAlign: Use installed ASR timestamps or align reviewed text with Qwen3 ForcedAligner.
可加速声码器，但需要兼容的 CUDA 编译环境；默认关闭更稳妥。: May speed up the vocoder; needs compatible CUDA build tools. Off by default.
可填 language、prompt 等服务特有字段；留空使用默认请求。: Optional service fields such as language or prompt; blank uses the default request.
合并成一部=适合直接发布；分别处理并输出=每条音轨独立处理，不生成合并版；分轨输: Merged: one deliverable. Per-track: independent outputs without a merged copy. Both: retain each track and the combined output.
同一作品可能有无损、压缩或不同语言版本；先选要处理的一组。: Choose one group when a work includes lossless, compressed or alternate-language versions.
在成品开头加入相同长度的空档，让作品内容整体后移。: Adds an initial gap and shifts the complete work later.
在批量页可以按作品修改；译文使用“翻译”页的服务。: Override per work in Batch processing; uses the configured translation provider.
在每句边缘加入极短渐变以减少爆音和咔哒声；过大可能吃掉短音节，默认 8 ms。: Short edge fades reduce clicks. Excessive fades may remove brief syllables; default 8 ms.
在自动匹配或统一响度之后，再整体提高或降低中文；通常保持 0，优先调整上面的主要: Final Chinese gain after matching/normalization. Usually keep 0 and adjust the main loudness controls first.
填写正数；只影响选择“和谐静态视频”的任务。: Positive value; applies only to harmonized static-video tasks.
增加变化但会降低逐句一致性，批量配音建议关闭。: Adds variation but reduces sentence-to-sentence consistency. Leave off for batch dubbing.
多句中文重叠时限制合计峰值，避免中文中间轨削波；默认 -3。: Caps combined Chinese-stem peaks during overlap; default −3 dBFS.
小于 1 缩短生成音频，大于 1 拉长；混音仍会按时间窗处理。: Below 1 shortens synthesis, above 1 lengthens it. Mix scheduling still applies.
展开数字、符号等常见写法。使用精确发音标注时可按需要关闭。: Expands numbers and symbols. Disable when using precise pronunciation notation if needed.
开启后，批量队列会显示选择器并提醒；关闭后直接使用自动推荐的项目片段。: Pause for a reference selector in batch mode; otherwise use the recommended project clip.
打开批量处理页时填入；不会锁定每个作品的选择。: Initial value on the batch page; each work remains editable.
扫描后会直接选中推荐图片；也可以改选其它图片或黑色背景。: Selects a suggested image after scanning; choose another or a black background if needed.
抑制重复发音；默认 10 为官方推荐值。: Suppresses repeated speech; upstream default is 10.
持续收到识别进度时不会因总耗时超过该值而停止。: An idle timeout, not a total runtime limit while progress continues.
按上方选择写在时间戳前或后；留空则不添加。所有作品共用。: Shared across works; placed before/after timestamps as selected. Blank adds nothing.
支持 BF16 的 NVIDIA 显卡可减少显存占用；不支持时自动回退全精度。: BF16 reduces memory on supported NVIDIA GPUs; otherwise falls back to full precision.
数值越接近 0 越响；默认 -30 dBFS。: Closer to 0 is louder; default −30 dBFS.
新建项目时使用。当前已经打开的项目会保留自己的语言；导入原文台本时直接沿用当前项: Applies to new projects. Existing projects and imported source scripts retain the project's language.
日语和英语分别保存。直接编辑会改为自定义；点击下方按钮可恢复当前语言的内置版本。: Stored separately for Japanese/English. Editing makes it custom; restore the built-in prompt below.
更大可能提高稳定性，也会增加计算量。: Higher values may improve consistency at greater compute cost.
本地 IndexTTS 可以使用 CPU，但通常比 CUDA 慢很多；Edge: Local IndexTTS supports CPU but is usually much slower. Edge and cloud APIs ignore this device setting.
每个源作品目录下都会建立这个子文件夹，用来保存 AutoFlow 成品和状态。: Created under each source work to store AutoFlow outputs and state.
每步只从概率最高的候选中采样；0 表示不限制。: Sample from the highest-probability candidates; 0 disables this limit.
用于分轨文件名和曲目清单；关闭后保留原音轨标题。: For per-track filenames and listings; disable to preserve original track titles.
用于成品标题和时间戳文档；关闭后保留原文件夹名称。: For output titles and timestamps; disable to retain the original folder name.
用于控制语气、情绪和表达风格；文字设计音色模型留空时使用温柔自然的中文女声。: Delivery, emotion and style instructions. Voice design defaults to a gentle, natural Chinese female voice.
用于服务商特有字段，例如 reasoning_effort、enable_thi: Provider fields such as reasoning_effort, enable_thinking or thinking. Do not override model, messages or stream.
留空时使用程序目录内的 .asmr-dubber/projects。: Blank uses .asmr-dubber/projects under the application directory.
纯音频=只生成音频；普通静态视频=原声从 0 秒开始；和谐静态视频=按设置降低并: Audio only; ordinary static video starts the source at 0; harmonized video attenuates and delays it as configured.
规范化后限制每句的瞬时峰值，防止单句削波；默认 -9。: Per-sentence peak protection after normalization; default −9 dBFS.
视频任务另存原声字幕版 MP4，保留无字幕原声；烧录失败会报错，不回退软字幕。纯: Adds an original-audio subtitled MP4 while retaining the unsubtitled version. Burn-in failures raise errors; audio-only output is unaffected.
识别文字不变；该模型只重新寻找每句话的起止时间。: Text stays unchanged; the model only relocates sentence boundaries.
负数让中文更轻，0 接近原片段音量，正数让中文更突出；默认 -8 dB。: Negative makes Chinese quieter, 0 approximates source level, positive emphasizes it; default −8 dB.
越高变化越大；官方推荐 0.8。: Higher means more variation; upstream recommends 0.8.
配音超过下一句开始时间时自动加速；最高可选 4×，达到上限后仍冲突则允许重叠。: Speed up when speech overlaps the next start, up to 4×. Remaining overlap is allowed at the limit.
长句会按此上限切段；减小可降低长文本对齐风险。: Splits long text at this limit; smaller values can reduce alignment risk.
限制单段最长输出；过小可能截断，过大会增加显存和等待时间。: Bounds output per segment. Too small truncates; too large increases memory and latency.
需要 flash-attn 等可选依赖，兼容性要求较高。: Requires optional dependencies such as flash-attn and compatible hardware/runtime.
需要同名翻译字幕请选择“仅字幕文件”，再选择字幕内容。命名规则在“设置 → 自动: For translated subtitles named after the audio, select subtitle files only, then content. Naming is under Settings → AutoFlow → Subtitles.
顺延模式不自动加速，也不会让两句中文互相叠加；连续长句可能逐渐晚于原字幕。: Sequential mode neither speeds up nor overlaps Chinese sentences. Long speech can accumulate delay.
首次编译等待较久，后续可能加速；需要 Triton。: Slow initial compilation may improve later runs; requires Triton.
默认 60 秒。到时未选择会自动继续，不会把队列判为失败。: Default 60 s; continues automatically on timeout rather than failing the queue.
尚未打开项目。请先选择下方音频语言，再新建或打开项目。: No project open. Select the source language, then create or open a project.
这里是设置草稿，切换页签不会丢失修改。保存前请选择作用范围；默认只修改新项目默认: Settings are drafts; tabs preserve edits. Choose a save scope. Defaults do not change an open project. Applying to a project uses the entire draft. API keys are stored under
可以直接修改启用状态、时间、原文和中文。把一行的原文与中文都清空，保存后会删除该: Edit enabled state, timing and text. Clearing both text fields deletes a sentence on save. Pages retain all drafts. Rightmost controls adjust/mute original vocals and Chinese speech; 0 dB inherits global gain. Original controls require separation. Playback switches preserve text and TTS caches; save and remix.
遇到缺 DLL、后端无法启动或 Python 依赖错误时使用。检测只运行启动/导: For missing DLLs, backend startup or dependency errors. Checks do not download models or run full inference. Repair preserves projects/models/results and does not rerun tasks.
保存服务地址后请先用短音频试运行: Save the endpoint, then test a short clip
程序、网页界面和外部 API 支持: Application, web UI and external API support
下方列出的 7 个固定模型及其运行依赖: Seven pinned models listed below and their runtimes
保持原时间点，冲突时自动加速: Keep source timing; speed up on overlap
先运行 ASR/翻译，再用大模型校对台本（推荐）: Run ASR/translation, then LLM script matching (recommended)
密钥已保存（只存本机，不写入项目）。: Key saved locally, not in the project.
按台词长度估算（无需模型，之后手动校对）: Estimate from text length (no model; review timing manually)
本地后端不需要 Key。: Local backends do not need an API key.
自动：回填未配音句子的分离人声: Auto: retain separated vocals for undubbed sentences
中文替换为实验性，不推荐。普通双语保留完整原声；RTF 独立控制中文空间处理。: Chinese replacement is experimental, not recommended. Bilingual mode keeps the full source; RTF independently processes Chinese spatial cues.
不依赖人声分离，双语和替换模式均可使用。仅处理中文，不混入原日语波形。: Independent of separation; works in both mix modes. Processes Chinese only, without adding the Japanese waveform.
逗号或空格分隔，如 s000006,s000010。不是回填完整背景。自动模式不: Comma/space-separated IDs, e.g. s000006,s000010. Restores vocals, not the whole background. Auto mode does not guarantee nonverbal content.
修改后在页面底部保存到当前项目或两者。RTF 只需重新混音；分离设置会标记 AS: Save to Current project/Both below. RTF requires only remixing; separation changes mark ASR stale and require rerunning affected stages.
设置冲突：中文替换需要开启人声分离。请改回双语或开启分离后保存。: Conflict: replacement requires separation. Select bilingual or enable separation before saving.
需要先在“人声分离”页开启分离才能选择中文替换；不会自动开启或下载模型。: Enable separation in its tab before selecting replacement. No automatic enablement or model download.
中文替换可用；已有音频尚未分离时，混音阶段会先执行分离。: Replacement available. If stems are missing, mixing runs separation first.
实验性，不推荐。普通用户请保持关闭。: Experimental; not recommended. Leave disabled for ordinary use.
分离可能损伤耳语、呼吸和口腔声；背景可能残留日语。RTF（原声空间线索迁移）与混: Separation may damage whispers/breaths/mouth sounds and leave Japanese residue. RTF (original spatial cue transfer) and mix mode are under Mixing & subtitles.
开启后，ASR 使用分离人声；原录音保留作为 RTF 参考和双语混音源。: ASR uses separated vocals. The original remains the RTF reference and bilingual mix source.
下面参数可预先配置；未勾选启用时不会执行分离。: Parameters can be configured in advance; separation does not run while disabled.
切换模型后必须显式下载。清单在成功下载时更新，重启页面服务器载入。: Download explicitly after changing models. Successful downloads update the catalog; restart the server to reload it.
降低显存；不稳定时关闭。ONNX 架构是否使用 GPU 取决于独立环境的执行提供: Reduces VRAM; disable if unstable. ONNX GPU support depends on the isolated runtime's execution provider.
默认 1；过度归一化可能改变残差听感。: Default 1; excessive normalization may alter the residual.
通常 Vocals。切换多轨模型时必须确认此名称；其余原声通过互补残差保留。: Usually Vocals. Confirm the stem name for multi-stem models; remaining audio is retained as the residual.
Custom HTTP only. Remote endpoints require HTTPS; localhost may use HTTP.
Replicate 必须为 64 位十六进制版本 ID；自建接口填写其模型 ID: Replicate requires a 64-hex pinned version; custom endpoints use their model ID.
常见 audio 或 audio_file；不是下载地址。: Usually audio or audio_file; not a download URL.
